analysis: {'Project A': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Relatively clear – addresses a need for reliable power in emergencies and off-grid living. Sustainability depends entirely on scaling production and maintaining component sourcing.', 'Differentiation': '• Weak –  ‘Rugged’ and ‘industrial’ aren’t particularly unique in the power equipment market.
